npc/warden.doing: standing in the open court with her back to the wall, watching the rim

happening.subject: npc/warden
happening.text: The party comes in through the mouth and the Warden looks round.

happening.subject: npc/warden
happening.text: The Warden tells them how little of this place is rooms.

objectives.hint: The Warden stands in the open court.
objectives.title: Hear the Warden

happening.text: The party climbs to the ledge and, for the first time, is above the floor of the bowl.

objectives.hint: The stair up out of the gallery is on its north wall.
objectives.title: Climb to the ledge

happening.text: The party steps out onto the lip and the whole walk is behind them at once.

objectives.hint: Out of the gallery by its east arch.
objectives.title: Reach the lip

happening.text: The walk is done, and it was shorter than the sky over it.
